warning.serverPort: A wrong value makes the backend unreachable; recovery means editing .env and restarting.
warning.apiPrefix: A wrong value breaks routing, media URLs and the frontend proxy at once.
warning.corsOrigin: Restricting origins may block browser access entirely.
warning.jwtSecret: Changing this signs everyone out and invalidates all existing tokens.
warning.storagePath: Changing these may make existing attachments unreadable.
warning.s3Credentials: Secrets are never displayed; a wrong value breaks object storage.
warning.collectionEndpoint: Pointing this at a third party sends them barcodes and item text (no quantity, price, location or serial numbers).

NODE_ENV.label: Runtime environment
NODE_ENV.hint: development / production / test; read only at startup.

SERVER_PORT.label: Backend port
SERVER_PORT.hint: HTTP port of the backend, default 3001.

API_PREFIX.label: Route prefix
API_PREFIX.hint: Path prefix of the API (routes look like /api/items), default api.

LOG_LEVEL.label: Log level
LOG_LEVEL.hint: error / warn / info / debug / verbose, default info.

LOG_FORMAT.label: Log format
LOG_FORMAT.hint: pretty (colour, human readable) / json / nginx, default pretty.

LOG_ACCESS.label: Access log
LOG_ACCESS.hint: Whether to write HTTP access logs, default on.

DATA_DIR.label: Data directory
DATA_DIR.hint: Relative paths resolve from the server/ directory, default data; prefer /data with a volume in Docker.

UPLOAD_DIR.label: Upload directory
UPLOAD_DIR.hint: Leave blank to use the data directory plus /uploads.

STORAGE_DRIVER.label: Storage driver
STORAGE_DRIVER.hint: local keeps files on disk and serves them via the backend; s3 uses S3-compatible object storage.

S3_ENDPOINT.label: S3 endpoint
S3_ENDPOINT.hint: For self-hosted stores such as MinIO; blank uses the AWS default.

S3_BUCKET.label: S3 bucket
S3_BUCKET.hint: Required when the s3 driver is used.

S3_ACCESS_KEY.label: S3 access key
S3_ACCESS_KEY.hint: Write-only and never displayed; a wrong value breaks object storage.

S3_SECRET_KEY.label: S3 secret key
S3_SECRET_KEY.hint: Write-only and never displayed; a wrong value breaks object storage.

S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE.label: S3 path style
S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE.hint: Default on (needed by MinIO and similar); turn it off for native AWS.

DEFAULT_CURRENCY.label: Default currency for new families
DEFAULT_CURRENCY.hint: Primary currency of a new family, default CNY.

PUBLIC_BASE_URL.label: Public base URL
PUBLIC_BASE_URL.hint: QR codes become this URL plus /r/<token>; blank writes the token only.

JWT_SECRET.label: JWT signing secret
JWT_SECRET.hint: Signs login tokens; changing it signs everyone out.

ALLOW_REGISTRATION.label: Open registration
ALLOW_REGISTRATION.hint: When off, all sign-ups are refused (including invite links); existing accounts still sign in.

DATA_COLLECTION_ENABLED.label: Enable barcode data collection
DATA_COLLECTION_ENABLED.hint: Master switch; when off this instance sends nothing to the outside.

DATA_COLLECTION_ENDPOINT.label: Collection service URL
DATA_COLLECTION_ENDPOINT.hint: Address of the standalone service (like https://.../api/v1); blank means not configured.

DATA_COLLECTION_SUBMIT.label: Submit new barcode data
DATA_COLLECTION_SUBMIT.hint: Whether to send back barcode data entered on this instance to help others.

DATA_COLLECTION_SYNC_ENABLED.label: Enable scheduled full sync
DATA_COLLECTION_SYNC_ENABLED.hint: Reports every item with a barcode to the collection service; barcode lookups are unaffected when off.

DATA_COLLECTION_SYNC_CRON.label: Sync schedule
DATA_COLLECTION_SYNC_CRON.hint: Cron expression with 6 fields (second minute hour day month weekday), default 0 0 3 * * * (daily at 03:00).

DATA_COLLECTION_SYNC_MAX_ITEMS.label: Max items per run
DATA_COLLECTION_SYNC_MAX_ITEMS.hint: Default 500; the rest waits for the next run.

DATA_COLLECTION_SYNC_THROTTLE_MS.label: Delay between items
DATA_COLLECTION_SYNC_THROTTLE_MS.hint: Milliseconds, default 250, to avoid overloading the collection service.

DATA_COLLECTION_SYNC_MAX_FAILURES.label: Max consecutive failures
DATA_COLLECTION_SYNC_MAX_FAILURES.hint: Default 5; the run is abandoned and retried next time.

setup.title: Set up HomeBucket
setup.subtitle: A couple of minutes: connect a database, create the first account, then confirm the instance settings.
setup.dbDetected: Detected the current connection (use "Change" to edit it).
setup.dbIntro: Enter the database connection. After saving, the backend restarts with the new settings and the wizard continues.
setup.dbLockedHint: Inside a container the database file is fixed at /data (the only mount point) and cannot be changed.
setup.restartTimeout: Timed out waiting for the backend to restart; check the container logs and reload this page.
setup.adminIntro: This account becomes the instance admin: only it can change instance-level settings.
setup.settingsIntro: These are prefilled with the current values (from .env or the built-in defaults); change only what you need.
setup.collectionIntro: Sync barcodes and item info with the shared collection service? You can turn this off at any time.
setup.collectionConsent: When enabled this instance sends the collector: barcodes and the item text fields (name, description, model, manufacturer, base unit). Photos have all metadata (EXIF, GPS, camera parameters) stripped before upload. Quantity, price, location, serial numbers and trace codes are never sent.
